newsitem.title: USA: Modine sees better margins, sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Modine sees better margins, sales growth.

text.p: Modine Manufacturing Co said it expects improving margins, with further benefits to profit levels as revenues increase.

Chief Executive Richard Savage said, "The near-term outlook ... sees stronger sales to some industrial and building-HVAC markets, balanced by more modest growth elsewhere. Unit sales volumes will be up but the increase could be substantially offset by adverse currency fluctuations, as indicated by current exchange rates. Sales, therefore, should grow only modestly this year, excluding any acquisitions."
For the fiscal year ended March 31, Modine sales were $999 million and net earnings were $63.8 million.
Modine makes heat-transfer systems for the vehicular, industrial, commercial and building markets.
